value.rationale: This is a complete, natural optimum-preserving forest-deletion relocation problem on a canonical cubic incidence graph. Distinguishing local versus arbitrary moves is motivated by actual network movement costs. The six-step sharp surcharge for 210 pairs, a radius jump from six to nine, and the complete 4,088,370-pair routing census are meaningful exact invariants not supplied by the prior optimizer census; the fixed 20-vertex case is transparently scoped.
